minor.issue: Endpoints revert po.qty_diterima/qty_staffed BEFORE validating remaining. If Pydantic passes but sisa validation later raises HTTPException, the pre-revert already subtracted from the PO counter, leaving PO in a stale (partially-decremented) state. Observed as a TEST_ITER6_UPST PO showing qty_staffed=-10 in Rekap after a deliberate 400 test. Suggest wrapping in a try/except that re-applies the old delta on validation failure, or validate first (using existing counter minus own contribution) before touching PO. Not blocking the reviewed features.

action_items: (OPTIONAL/MINOR) Harden update_bm & update_staffing to re-apply the reverted delta if the subsequent sisa validation raises 400 - otherwise a failed edit leaves the PO counter partially decremented. Simple fix: wrap the validation+re-apply block in try/except that undoes the initial revert on any exception. Left one TEST_ITER6_UPST PO with qty_staffed=-10 as evidence.
(OPTIONAL/CLEANUP) Delete lingering TEST_ITER6_* barang & PO records now that testing is complete; they clutter the Rekap PO tab.
(OPTIONAL/CODE QUALITY) server.py is now 1748 lines - modularize (routes/, models/) - unchanged from iter4/5 recommendation.
critical_code_review_comments: update_po (line 484-527) correctly reads existing_counters by barang_id, but if a PO edit REMOVES a barang_id that had qty_diterima/qty_staffed > 0, that history is silently lost. Consider forbidding removal of items with non-zero counters or logging a warning.
update_bm (line 1253) and update_staffing (line 1311) revert-before-validate ordering means a failed PUT (400 sisa) leaves the PO counter mutated. Reproduced during iter6 testing.
server.py 1748 lines still needs splitting into modules (models.py, routes/po.py, routes/barang_masuk.py, routes/staffing.py, routes/rekap.py).

No transaction/atomicity across the multi-step update flow (revert -> validate -> apply) in update_bm/update_staffing. MongoDB is used without sessions; a crash between revert and re-apply corrupts state.

BarangMasukItem/StaffingItem models allow lots of optional passthrough metadata (nama_barang, harga_pengrajin, harga_jual) that are then overwritten server-side from the PO snapshot - fine but tightly couples client<->server schema.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no reproduction needed. All fixes verified pass. Minor observation (revert-before-validate in update_bm/staffing) documented above with clear reproduction: 1) create staffing qty=4 on qty=20 PO -> qty_staffed=4; 2) PUT same staffing to qty=999 -> 400 with 'sisa'; 3) inspect PO -> qty_staffed is now -4 (should still be 4).
